summary: Created appworker on node1 and configured all login sessions for 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified the limits before and after a safe node restart; RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created appworker with /home/appworker and /bin/bash; its password remains locked.
Added root-owned /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf with soft and hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256.
Verified effective limits through a PAM-backed appworker login session.
Safely restarted node1, confirmed its boot ID changed, and verified full recovery and persistence.

evidence.summary: Shows appworker UID/GID, home, shell, and persistence after restart.

evidence.requirement: Limit login sessions to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Actual PAM-backed appworker sessions report soft and hard limits of 8192 open files and 256 processes, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL Server 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Captures healthy baseline with boot ID a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID f9a4e24f-b71d-42c8-9259-1d181d3edc81, and recovered system/account/limits state.
